label: Nose / Cockpit
job: Where the pilot sits and controls the plane.
ifMissing: The plane cannot be properly controlled.

label: Fuselage
job: The main body holding the people and systems.
ifMissing: There is no proper body to connect the plane parts.

label: Wings
job: Help the plane create lift and stay in the air.

label: Tail
job: Helps the plane stay balanced and turn correctly.

label: Fuel Tank
job: Stores the fuel needed for the trip.
ifMissing: The plane may stop during the mission.
